# DrapixAI

> DrapixAI is developing upper-body virtual try-on for fashion brands. The website is in pre-launch preparation. Live availability, commercial permissions and controlled-pilot acceptance remain subject to launch review. This optional reference file is not an indexing instruction, access control or a guarantee of AI citations.

## Public documentation

- Developer quickstart: /docs
- Merchant guide and answers: /virtual-try-on
- Help and troubleshooting: /help
- Service status: /status
- Changelog: /changelog
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms

## Intended launch scope

Current upper-body evaluation scope includes eligible shirts, t-shirts, polos, blouses and clean tops. Each product needs review; listing a garment category is not proof that every product or generated result is suitable for publication.
The intended shopper pipeline uses Standard quality only. A development Shopify integration is not evidence of an App Store listing or live-store acceptance.

## Browser SDK

Load `/sdk.js` from the DrapixAI web origin. Initialize it with a short-lived, product-scoped storefront token (or a token provider) and a confirmed product ID on a verified storefront domain. Permanent server API keys must not be put in browsers. Live products require a prepared garment cache and confirmed product mapping.

Important SDK result metadata includes quality score, confidence badge, latency, warnings, candidate count, garment source, and cache status.

## Quality policy

Automated checks can reject outputs with detected identity, pose, garment, coverage or realism defects. A score or badge is not a guarantee of visual accuracy, physical fit or commercial results; human product review remains necessary.

## Privacy

Shopper photos require consent. Retention and deletion behavior is documented on the privacy page. Production integrations should use only HTTPS, verified storefront domains, and protected server-side management routes.
